detail.longDescription: Let's say you buy your dog's favorite treats online. As soon as you hit that purchase button, you'll receive an email confirmation. Probably a shipping update, too. And a delivery success message once those goodies have arrived. Next, you receive a welcome email which offers you tips and resources on pet care and a thank-you discount on poodle carriers for giving a five-star review.
